summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign with an exciting new-look squad featuring several fresh signings and a returning player. The Ramblers showed competitive spirit in their recent friendly against St Helens, though they'll be looking to sharpen their finishing as they prepare for the season ahead. The club is also on the hunt for kit and squad sponsorship deals, so get in touch if you're interested in supporting the team!
